part.label: Grommet With Torus Ring
part.description: A mounting plate with a torus ring resting on top, the classic grommet/O-ring seal shape -- the `torus` component kind sits with its base (not its center) at Z=0 on its own local origin, the same convention as every other kind, so it composes with `on_top_of` exactly like any other component.

components.description: Grommet ring, resting on top of the plate via an ordinary on_top_of relation. Lies flat (its axis along Z) by default.
